verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own rule-based triggers. An APM issue rule can automatically create a PagerDuty incident, the pricing page lists custom alerts via email, Slack or Teams, and error statuses support 'Ignore by rule'. The documented actions are limited to alerting and incident creation, with no general-purpose rule engine or configurable action types shown. Missing for 10: documentation of how rule conditions and event types are defined, a broader range of automated actions beyond notifications and PagerDuty incidents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Now when an issue is triggered from this rule, a PagerDuty incident will be created and your incident team will be notified by PagerDuty.
